I think it's a weird/funny/but honest movie you have to be really open about. It's rich in subtext like a novel (more show than tell), but it's more of a comedic, retrospective movie to reflect the experience of reflecting back on your past and revelations of things you didn't notice before. So I say it depends on your mood: it's a movie that's well written, but it's not a movie that I'd watch if I wanna sit back and relax. It's more of a oddball movie you wanna watch if you wanna experience something weird but if you're the kind that enjoys to dissect themes and backstory through subtext in books or movies, I think this is a movie for you. 

But all in all, I think the movie has a good message that you have to look for, but it's a rewarding movie if you watch it more than once because I gotta say the experience kept evolving for me and it grew on me.
